## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

## Code Review

This pull request adds `kv_transfer_params` to the `ChatCompletionStreamResponse` and `CompletionStreamResponse` models to support vLLM-specific extensions in streaming responses. The feedback suggests adding descriptions to these fields for consistency with the corresponding non-streaming models.

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

For consistency with the `ChatCompletionResponse` model (line 110), please add a description to this field. This helps users understand the purpose of this vLLM-specific extension in the streaming response.

```suggestion
    kv_transfer_params: dict[str, Any] | None = Field(
        default=None, description="KVTransfer parameters."
    )
```

+    # vLLM-specific: KV transfer params returned with the final chunk

nodes.body:
@DarkLight1337 what's your take on allowing this interface change?
The use case is that of long multi-turn chats in which allowing D cache to be pulled from P it's going to be increasingly important.
@snadampal also, I think we may want to add changes to toy_proxy_server.py in order to allow this feature. Perhaps better to add the changes here https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/32553

Sorry, I might be missing something. My understanding is that `stream=true` mainly applies to the decoding stage.

Why do we need to introduce `kv_params` in the streaming API?

As I understand it, for the prefill stage, requests are always `stream=false`. So when requests reach the prefill node, they are all configured with `stream=false`. For reference: [https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/tests/v1/kv_connector/nixl_integration/toy_proxy_server.py#L170](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/tests/v1/kv_connector/nixl_integration/toy_proxy_server.py#L170)
LGTM @snadampal could you rebase?
